name: dsh-org-talent
description: Organization-wide employee matching in the DSH left sidebar: editable current project requirements with pool sync; default team configuration with missing-role/skill prompts; project progress with outcomes and alerts; product acceptance and duplicate-development guards; editable talent profiles and drag-to-team org chart; one best team with a persistent base team; local SVG summary charts; one-paste feedback, memo, requirement pool, project conversations and capability advice. · 左侧栏的组织人才匹配：当前项目需求可编辑并同步需求池；默认团队配置显示缺口角色与技能点；项目进度、成果与预警；产品验收与重复开发拦截；人才库编辑、组织架构拖拽调队；一组最佳团队与基础团队；本地数据图；粘贴反馈、备忘录、需求池、项目对话与培养建议。
